revision_log: research/preregistration_revisions.md (revisions 1 and 2 recorded before any raster evaluation)
status: pre-registered, not yet run on GEMS input data
hypothesis: Line-like responses supported by DEM curvature and at least one potential-field gradient, with H0 persistence greater than 2 epsilon at at least two adjacent smoothing scales, rank above single-scale threshold artifacts at matched prediction budget.

layers.magnetic: metadata-identified total magnetic intensity or reduced-to-pole magnetic anomaly

transform.dem: mask-aware Gaussian smoothing then scale-normalized Hessian anisotropy
transform.magnetic: mask-aware Gaussian smoothing then scale-normalized horizontal gradient magnitude
transform.gravity: mask-aware Gaussian smoothing then scale-normalized horizontal gradient magnitude
transform.constant_response_rule: if the fitted response 99.5th percentile is not above its median, use zero response

persistence.filtration: superlevel sets of robustly normalized nonnegative ridge/edge response

fusion.layer_aggregation: arithmetic mean of positive persistence-weighted family scores where minimum layer support is met
fusion.scale_aggregation: maximum persistence-weighted response over the configured scales
fusion.normalization: robust percentiles per field; output score is a rank signal, not a calibrated probability

evaluation.truth: public catalogue labels only; catalogue pseudo-holdout, not expert-only fault truth
evaluation.normalization_fit_scope: Within each fold, fit robust input and response percentiles on the other three full quadrants only; apply those fixed transforms across the complete unsupervised feature grid. No catalogue labels enter fit masks or transformations.
evaluation.matched_positive_pixel_budget: positive pixel count of the pinned educational H33-2-B2 reference TIFF
evaluation.top_budget_rule: select exactly k highest positive ranking scores; ties resolved by ascending row-major flat index; emit binary 1/0 values
evaluation.primary_control: single-scale DEM-curvature + magnetic-edge + gravity-edge ranking at sigma=2 pixels
evaluation.historical_control: H33-2-B2 public owner artifact, used only as an evaluation baseline; score/file attribution not organizer-verified

important_limits: The persistence theorem certifies diagram stability conditional on epsilon for each fixed transformed scalar field, not geological fault identity.
Spatial matching of bars across Gaussian sigmas is heuristic; it has no formal multiparameter stability claim.
The public-catalogue holdout is not a direct proxy for new expert-only faults.
Parameters are fixed before the input rasters are available; changes after observing holdout results require a new preregistration and untouched evaluation data.
